Body.Content:
Now makers will have clear visibility into their consumption costs directly within Monitor tab at both a per-agent level and an estimated breakdown of those costs across the agents lifecylce. This will allow makers to see costs distributed across activities such as authoring, testing, evaluations, and production usage, helping connect overall consumption to specific actions and experiences.

GA date: September CY2026
